title: Employment Situation (Jun 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, on the session the recommended cash-bond tape shuts at 14:00
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday following the end of the reference week, the week containing the 12th. bls.gov/schedule/news_release/2027_sched.htm and bls.gov/schedule/schedule/2027_sched.htm were BOTH FETCHED AND BOTH RETURNED HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-09 under a browser user-agent (the documented bls.gov blind spot for this lane, ppi-2026-11-13.md), so the prefix is EST: and not BLS:, and the block is recorded in this proposer's probe-ref. THE RULE WAS VALIDATED BEFORE IT WAS APPLIED, 7 for 7: it reproduces all four confirmed jobs entries already on this calendar (jobs-2026-09-04, jobs-2026-10-02, jobs-2026-11-06, jobs-2026-12-04) and all three historical Sunday-July-4 years (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For June 2027 the reference week is Sun 2027-06-06 to Sat 2027-06-12, and the third Friday after 06-12 is 2027-07-02. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY sifma-bond-early-close-2027-07-02's initial research (2026-09-09) at D-0 — the same calendar date as its proposer, and the single fact that changes what that session is. WHY IT IS NOT A COINCIDENCE, AND WHY IT RECURS: June 12 falls on a Saturday exactly when July 4 falls on a Sunday (July 4 is 22 days after June 12, and 22 mod 7 = 1). So in EVERY Sunday-July-4 year the June reference week ends Saturday June 12, the third Friday after it is July 2, and that is also the session SIFMA flanks the observed Monday holiday with a 2:00 p.m. ET early close. The identity held in 2004, 2010 and 2021 and holds again in 2027. WHAT IT COMPOSES INTO: a tier-1 macro print at 08:30 ET into a cash fixed-income tape that shuts six and a half hours later, while NYSE runs a full session to 16:00 ET (its 2027 grid carries no early-close asterisk on Independence Day — verified first-hand by the proposer). HONEST LIMITS. (1) STATUS IS ESTIMATE AND MUST STAY THERE until bls.gov's 2027 schedule is actually retrieved; a derived date is not a published one, and this lane may not self-confirm an in-sweep find. Promotion trigger: any successful fetch of the BLS 2027 release schedule naming this date, which flips the prefix to BLS: and the status to confirmed. (2) BLS HAS MOVED THIS RELEASE FOR HOLIDAYS BEFORE — in Saturday-July-4 years the rule lands on the observed-holiday Friday and the release shifts earlier, so the rule is not unconditional. It is unconditional HERE only because 2027-07-02 is itself a full trading day. (3) IMPACT high matches every other jobs-* entry on this calendar; symbols [] matches them too. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
